claims.statement: Re-measurement of LOT-1239 on MET02 is 519.35, matching the alarm and confirming the film is really thick, not a misread
After 68.7 lots from CLN02 are high at 519.07 and 523.43 and 519.63 and 519.24 while lots from CLN01 are normal at 503.87 and 498.11 and 500.04
DEP01-A also jumped to 519.07 at 68.7 with last PM at 66.61, showing the same shift on a second chamber
DEP01-B sensors are normal with z-scores of -0.0 and -0.4 and 0.1 and 0.3, so no chamber process shift
CLN02 mean is 508.39 versus CLN01 at 502.14 with p-value 0.0447, while DEP p-value is 0.2286

disposition.summary: Re-measurement confirms the thick film is real. High lots come only from CLN02 across both DEP01-A and DEP01-B starting around 68.7, with normal chamber sensors, pointing to CLN02 upstream. Hold the alarm lot and escalate CLN02.

Re-measurement confirms the thickness shift is real, and a second chamber shows the same jump — checking equipment sensors to narrow the source.

sources.practitioner: Equipment or upstream problems are suspected when abnormal lots cluster in one group. One contact called upstream and shared-facility effects very frequent; the other thought them rare. We keep the scenario and note the disagreement.
